{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[Mak Luunim]] owned a [[Datacard/Legends|'''datacard''']] that contained access codes to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] secret financial accounts.<ref name="Target">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], accompanied by fellow Rebels [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]]&mdash;who was secretly the Imperial assassin [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] tasked to assassinate the rebel pilot who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]&mdash;went to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] to retrieve the datacard from Luunim. They arrived late, however, as Luunim was already dead by the time Skywalker and the others arrived. The datacard was taken by [[Nal Kenuun]], a notorious [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]], in payment of Luunim's debt to him.<ref name="Target" />

The Rebels looked for Kenuun's whereabouts, only to be captured by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under Kenuun's employ. Faced with the gambler himself, Skywalker agreed to race for Kenuun in a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] [[Muunilinst Podrace|event]] in exchange for the datacard. Skywalker managed to win the race and Kenuun handed the datacard over to the Rebels. As they were about to leave, Kenuun ordered his stormtroopers to subdue the Rebels, intending collecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on Solo and Elad. A standoff ensued and was only broken when Organa captured Kenuun's pet [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] and threatened to harm it if they were not allowed safe passage offworld.<ref name="Target" />
